result.instructions: Tools for Buddy Punch, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who clocked in late at our Berlin location this week?"; "Show the time card totals for this pay period for everyone with overtime."; "Punch in Jane Smith at 08:00 today and note that she started at the warehouse.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Buddy Punch data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run buddypunch_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run buddypunch_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run buddypunch_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. buddypunch_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: buddypunch_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees of the company: name, email, active and manager flags, hire and termination dates, time zone. Needs the employees:read scope. GET /employee.

startingAfter.description: Next page: pass the id of the last item of the previous page.

endingBefore.description: Previous page: pass the id of the first item of the current page.

tools.name: buddypunch_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id, with pay amount, break rule, overtime type and time entry mode. Needs employees:read. GET /employee/{id}.

id.description: The numeric id of the record.

tools.name: buddypunch_punch_in
tools.title: Punch in an employee
tools.description: Record a clock-in for an employee now or at punchDateTime. Changes the time records. Needs punches:write. POST /punch/in.

punchDateTime.description: When the punch happened. Omit it to use the server time.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when you retry the same write, so it does not run twice. Omit it for a new write.

tools.name: buddypunch_punch_out
tools.title: Punch out an employee
tools.description: Record a clock-out for an employee now or at punchDateTime. Changes the time records. Needs punches:write. POST /punch/out.

punchDateTime.description: When the punch happened. Omit it to use the server time.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when you retry the same write, so it does not run twice. Omit it for a new write.

tools.name: buddypunch_start_break
tools.title: Start a break
tools.description: Start a break for an employee under one break rule. Changes the time records. Needs punches:write. POST /break/start.

breakRuleId.description: The break rule id, from the company's break rules.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when you retry the same write, so it does not run twice. Omit it for a new write.

tools.name: buddypunch_end_break
tools.title: End a break
tools.description: End the open break of an employee. Changes the time records. Needs punches:write. POST /break/end.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when you retry the same write, so it does not run twice. Omit it for a new write.

tools.name: buddypunch_create_time_off_request
tools.title: Create a time off request
tools.description: Create a time off request for an employee: hours per day or per date range, with a time off type. Needs pto:write. POST /timeOff.

isDateRange.description: True when the request covers a date range (use endDate in each entry).

endDate.description: Last day of the entry, for a date range.

ptoEarningCodeId.description: Time off type id, from buddypunch_list_time_off_types.

ptoHoursTuples.description: One entry per day or per period.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when you retry the same write, so it does not run twice. Omit it for a new write.
